summary: The diff implements most of the required changes. REQ-2 (suppress loading flash) and parts of REQ-1 (phase-based Admin link rendering) are well implemented in Navigation.tsx and useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout.ts. REQ-3 (backend verification/diagnostic trace) is partially addressed — the backend file is modified but no diagnostic log or trace is visible in the truncated diff. REQ-1's hardcoded principal fallback is present in useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout.ts but the HARDCODED_ADMIN_PRINCIPAL constant is left empty (''), meaning the fallback will never actually trigger, which undermines the core acceptance criteria for REQ-1.

missing_requirements.requirement: A hardcoded fallback principal check is implemented so that the known admin principal always sees the Admin link, even when isCallerAdmin is loading or errors.
missing_requirements.reason: The HARDCODED_ADMIN_PRINCIPAL constant in useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout.ts is set to an empty string (''), so the fallback check isHardcodedAdmin will always be false. The feature is structurally present but functionally inert — the admin principal will not benefit from the fallback. The AC requires the fallback to actually resolve to true for the designated admin principal.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add a diagnostic trace or log to the isCallerAdmin backend method if helpful; verify the method correctly returns true for the admin principal.
missing_requirements.reason: The backend/main.mo diff is truncated and no diagnostic trace or log is visible in the provided content. It is unclear whether a log was added or whether the method was explicitly verified or modified for the admin principal check.
